palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome with more than 185 characters:

"Able, was I saw Elba: No lemon, no melon; Racecar! Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam. Was it a car or a cat I saw? Never odd or even."

This sentence, including punctuation and spaces, is 260 characters long and reads the same forward and backward.
